why_the_stage_moved_without_a_drained_qu: The queue's top three cannot be advanced by implementing them. Rank 1 is blocked on two measurement definitions that are ADDRESS's; rank 6 needs one layer identified and its filed evidence was taken on a still that was two flat fills; rank 7's code half is pushed and its measurement is pixels of a capture. A capture unblocks all three, and it is also the only route to a score that is not eleven firings old. Argued in full in stage_change_note; the cheap correction is to set stage back to IMPLEMENT and drain ranks 8, 9 and 13 onward.
causes_established: HF_std as firing 28 defined it -- L minus a 2-px gaussian over the brightest 45% of the frame -- does not measure a sheet on a strip frame, because a strip frame is a whole phone screen at 148 px rather than a sheet on a dark desk. The brightest 45% of that is a scattered slice through an interface and HF over a scattered mask is mostly the scatter. PROOF: the firing 17 strip, from the era of the flat rectangle, reads 14.609-15.635 against today's repaired 14.317-15.088; a synthetic flat beige rectangle reads 14.372; eroding the mask 2 px collapses 06_unfolding to 3.7-4.8 on 1,173 pixels of 22,665. On a box that IS all sheet it works: rank 1's own --box sample reads 0.506 at 92d7b5a and 8.454 today.

Rank 1's still clause is a sampling accident rather than a property of the build. The same 300x120 window nudged over a 7x13 grid at +-24 px reads 18.873-40.393 today, median 31.421, 51 of 91 placements clearing the floor of 30 -- and 1.254-1.329, spread 0.076, 0 of 91, on the still it was filed against. A flat rectangle is flat wherever the window falls.

Rank 6's stated mechanism is wrong. MaskedLayer applies the mask with BlendMode.dstIn against its alpha -- the tear cuts, it does not overlay -- and RegionPad is torn: false, so a pad-backed screen has no tear on the pad at all. RULED OUT by measurement: drawImageNine at edge 0.4 stretches the setup sheet's vertical centre band ~8.2x against 1.00x horizontally, predicting left treads 8x the top's; measured 1.98x.
